method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; NOTHING, or a NOTHING-kind tag, where it does not answer); the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; three regulative rules (s 24 complain within 24 months; s 27(5) further information within the time fixed; s 51 the provider's report on remedial action within 45 days) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: The complaint a person harmed by a health or disability service makes, from the complainant's seat. In: s 3 (health service, excluded service, user), s 4(4); ss 19-22, 24-30, 32A, 33(a), 34, 35(1), 36A(3), (6), 36B, 36BA, 36C, 37(1), 39, 40(2)(a), 40(4), 41, 42, 43, 44(2), 50(2), 51, 52A(1), 52, 58, 71; the offences ss 21, 51, 52G, 52N, 52Q(2), 61, 62, 71, 72, 73. Out: Parts 2 and 4 (administration, the Director's powers, except the offences in ss 61, 62), Parts 3D and 3E (orders and warnings addressed to health care workers, except their offences), s 23 (administrative instructions not deposited), the Director's internal procedure, reports to Parliament, transitional provisions, Schedule 2. Reasons in NOTES.md.
